rows.en: Come on, let's move!
(I'd better do my best!!)

I'm all sticky with sweat, so I'll hurry
and go get changed...
...Please don't stare at me so much!
Give me back my uniform~!
This really ticks me off!!!
Wh-why the maid outfits...
We couldn't exactly change back into our gym clothes...
Today's P.E. was pretty intense, after all...

Honestly, if you want my clothes,
then come out and ask for them fair and square!
Th-there's no point getting mad at me...
What's the matter with you all?
What are you doing, Klan-senpai...
Hm? You mean this outfit?

Well, you see, I tripped while playing
in the schoolyard, so I borrowed this
from a teacher!
That's not exactly something to brag about...

Did Ranka and the others get their uniforms
dirty too?
No, that's not it~
Our uniforms got stolen...
So we're wearing these instead.
I see...

Right!
\p!!
We're going to find the culprit!!
B-but why?!
rows.notes: nan de desu ka (why?), the player objecting to being drafted.

rows.en:
Your classmates are suffering,
and you're just going to look the other way?!

I don't remember raising you to be
such a pathetic man!

And I don't remember being raised by you,
Senpai!

Anyway, let's go!
Follow me!
(Sigh, guess I have no choice...)

All of them? Who did it? How...!
Wait, mine didn't even get stolen...
Wh-why are you in maid outfits...?
Th-there's no point getting mad at me...

I don't remember raising you to be
such a pathetic woman!

And I don't remember being raised by you,
Senpai!

(Going out on my own once in a while
is nice, too...)

Wowww, the ocean really is the best!
All right, time to really kick back!
H-hey, isn't that...
The ocean really feels great, doesn't it~

Really. We're always stuck on the bridge.
We need to get outside once in a while...

Oh my, wouldn't anywhere do for you,
as long as the Captain was there?
rows.notes: Mina teasing Monica about Captain Wilder (kanchou).

rows.en: H-hey, Mina!

Oh, pardon me.
Well then, I think I'll go admire some young ones...
rows.notes: Mina: wakai ko wo mede ni.

rows.en:
Ooh, I like that, Mina!
The beach is all about waves, wind and men, right?!
Bobby-san and Mina-senpai sure love that stuff~
Geez, Canaria-san, please say something to them...
Don't worry about it. We're a team.

If they spot me, it'll turn into a huge mess...
I'll pretend I didn't see anything...
(Phew... So much for kicking back...)

(Going out on my own once in a while
is nice, too...)

Wowww, the ocean really is the best!
All right, time to really kick back!

If they spot me, I'll get dragged into a huge mess...
I'll pretend I didn't see anything...
(Phew... So much for kicking back...)

H-hey, Cathy...
Don't cling to me like that... Someone'll see us...
Huh? Ozma, that's mean...

Ah, no, sorry...
I was just thinking, if the S.M.S. guys saw us here...

Oh? Isn't the only one you're really worried
about Ranka-chan?

Of course not!
The one I worry about most is... you.
Huh?!
rows.notes: Cathy; x98 across many scenes and speakers.

rows.en: ...I'll pretend I didn't see anything...
(Ozma-san and Cathy-san sure are close...)
...I'll pretend I didn't see anything...
(Ozma-san and Cathy-san sure are close...)

uncertain: c02541: plate '??? (woman)' is Klan (named in c02542); line kept as her question to the group.
c02544: Klan borrowed the outfit from 'a teacher' (sensei, which one not stated).
c02569: kanchou rendered 'the Captain' (Captain Wilder, whom Monica adores).
c02571: Mina's 'wakai ko wo mede ni ikou kashira' rendered 'go admire some young ones'.
c02588/c02590: also used in ext_oth_903/904 (not in my slices); kept generic.
c02589/c02591: the player calls them Ozma-san and Cathy-san as in the Japanese.
